::: {.lead}
Tennessee Titans finished 2025 at 3&ndash;14. The model grades them as a rebuilder: bottom-quartile passing offence. Nothing else matters until that changes.
:::

## What the four phases look like

::: {.sec-note}
EPA **per play** in each of the four phases. Blue is creating points, red is costing them. Defence is sign-flipped so longer blue always means better. All four bars share one league-wide scale (max 0.306 EPA/play), so they are comparable to each other *and* to every other team page. Season totals are deliberately not used here &mdash; mixing totals and per-play rates on one axis would make the offence bars look four times longer than they are.
:::

## Identity

This team classifies as **Rebuilder** &mdash; *Bottom-quartile passing offence. Nothing else matters until that changes.*

Underneath, the offence reads as **"Marginal — Passing Needs Fixing"**: the label describes how the offence distributes its production between the run and the pass, not how good it is.

| Dimension | Grade |
|---|---|
| Offence tier | **Poor** |
| Defence tier | **Poor** |
| Pass defence rank | **#29** |
| Rush defence rank | **#20** |
| Wins above / below model | **+0.2** |

## Personnel

**Quarterback.** **C.Ward** closed the season at **-0.114 EPA per dropback** and **0.1% CPOE** over his rolling five-game window (through week 17).

**Running back.** **T.Pollard** led the backfield with **241 carries** at **-0.086 EPA per rush** (4.5 YPC, 39.4% success). Blocking versus creation: **2.6** yards before contact, **1.8** after. Style: *Contact creator*.

## 2026 outlook

The multi-year prior model projects **5.1 wins** for 2026, with a 90% interval of **0.0 to 11.7**. Fragility flag: **Neutral**.
